notes.title: May 15, 2023: v1.1.6 Patch
notes.content:
[b]May 15, 2023: v1.1.6 [/b]
[list]
[*] Improve performance by optimizing clearing texture assets from memory during battle.
[*] Improve performance by optimizing clearing texture assets from memory in the overworld.
[*] Reduce texture load by removing redundant frames from animated assets.
[*] Adjust Charge UI to fit up to 11 Charge.
[*] Polish on Laguna Collision to minimize getting stuck on objects when traversing the overworld.
[*] Create a gap in Rizal CH9 rock and tail laser puzzle to prevent soft lock in the instance that the laser does not break the rocks.
[*] Fix missing/broken localization for Japanese language tutorials in battle.
[*] Fix missing/broken localization for Japanese language in cutscenes.
[*] Increase Bass Volume for Metal Zero rhythm track. 
[*] Add delay to exiting Upgrade and Shop Menu on startup to prevent UI errors.
[*] Remove treble cut when in Attack Menu in battle.
[/list]

notes.title: May 1, 2023: v1.1.5 Patch
notes.content:
[b]May 1, 2023: v1.1.5[/b]
[list]
[*] Set sword in CH11 Laguna room to be retriggerable to avoid possible softlock. 
[*] Set Third Temple doors to be permanently open to avoid possible softlock. 
[*] Fixed issue where tutorial for overworld run has error text in Japanese Localization.
[*] Fixed issue where pressing Rhythm Game input in a certain window will result in no Perfect/Good/Miss text.
[*] Fixed issue where random misses will occur in some instances.
[*] Adjusted Rhythm Game overall difficulty to be slightly easier. 
[/list]

notes.title: April 17, 2023: v1.1.4 Patch
notes.content:
[b]April 17, 2023: v1.1.4[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix issue where certain doors in CH1 Makati and CH 4 Cebu were being reset in-between patches.
[*] Added hotfixes for players currently stuck in those specific rooms (collision trigger to set doors to open when approached).
[*] Set certain swords to be retriggerable in CH1 Makati and CH 4 Cebu to circumvent players who have been stuck in those areas.
[*] Fix missing collision in Laguna 3-2.
[*] Set Mini Boss in Rizal 3-7 to fully disappear after defeat.
[*] Set Dialogue Indicators for Port Island Exits for clarity.
[*] Set Dialogue Indicators for Stone Core receptacles for clarity. 
[/list]

notes.title: April 11, 2023: v1.1.3 Patch
notes.content:
[b]April 11, 2023: v1.1.3[/b]
[list]
[*] Rhythm Game collision polish with the goal of making hold notes more forgiving. Some songs with hold notes too close together had beatmaps modified as well.
[*] Fixed issue where Battle and Overworld Rhythm game had slight differences in button collision feel.
[*] Cebu CH7 Centipede and their Stone Cores have had their GUID’s reset and item value is set to reset back to 1 if value is less than 0.
[*] Switched the position of New Game and Load Game in the start menu to prevent players from accidentally going into New Game when mashing on the start screen.
[/list]

notes.title: April 10, 2023: v1.1.2 Patch
notes.content:
[b]April 8, 2023: v1.1.2[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Issue where late game cutscene SFX was missing.
[*] Fixed Issue where late game cutscene had a song looping issue.
[*] Increase player collision hit box slightly to address soft-lock collision issues. 
[*] Slight Fix to Cebu CH7 Wires
[*] Fixed layering Issue in Laguna CH2 scrap room.
[*] Fixed Issue where Overworld Music would sometimes continue to play into battle. 
[/list]

notes.title: April 8, 2023: v1.1.1 Patch
notes.content:
[b]April 8, 2023: v1.1.1[/b]
[list]
[*] Further adjustments to rhythm game button collision and behavior to fix issues with some mash/hold notes.
[*] Fixed issue where Overworld Rhythm Game backing track would be affected by SFX volume slider instead of Music volume slider.
[*] Set Volume scaling to be less linear so lower volume levels are more usable. 
[*] Fix to Cebu map where blocker icons were displayed as white instead of red.
[*] Fix to some Laguna houses not fully darkening the outside area when inside a building.
[*] Further adjustment to CH1 Tutorial Enemy health and damage.
[*] Removed hotfix to Cebu CH4. Bridges are set disabled again and stone cores should be collectable now. 
[*] Addressed various collision and layering issues in Cebu
[*] Addressed various collision and layering issues in Makati
[/list]

notes.title: Week 1 Patches
notes.content:
[b]March 30, 2023 v1.0.6[/b]
[list]
[*] Hotfix for Cutscene Bug (after defeating overworld boss in CH1)
[/list]
[b]March 31, 2023 v1.0.7[/b]
[list]
[*] Hotfix for stone core/bridge issue in Cebu CH4. Enabled bridges permanently.
[/list]
[b]April 3, 2023: v1.0.8[/b]
[list]
[*] Lower attack damage of tutorial enemies in CH1
[*] Slightly increase rhythm game note hitbox leeway.
[*] Fix for Back Input prompt for Keyboard in Save Menu and Attack Menu
[*] Fix issue with map markers not appearing CH1
[*] Set Miguel to disappear in Makati 1-7 (before boss room) if the player walks back after completing CH1. 
[*] Laguna 3-2 collision fix so sword isn’t triggerable from ledge.
[*] Cebu CH4 layering and collision polish
[*] Remove achievement triggers for old unused scrap achievement 
[*] Fix to Stone Cores not correctly registering in inventory after being initially consumed in first Stone Bridge Quest.
[*] Add Collision to the back area of Iris Shop in CH2 Laguna. 
[*] Disable Enemy in Rizal 3-1 CH3 (room after town) that was causing an encounter loop.
[/list]
[b]April 4, 2023: v1.0.9[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where map info would clear if a player quit to the start menu and loaded a new save.
[*] Fixed issue where WASD control for movement would get reset back to arrow keys after a scene change.
[*] Fixed an issue where if the player backtracked after Kaylee joins the party the scenario would get re-triggered.
[*] Fixed issue in the second temple where the dragon orbs would not work on the statues. Set the doors as permanently open. 
[*] Added additional waypoints to Rizal Island Map.
[*] Addressed various collision and layering issues in Rizal
[/list]
[b]April 6, 2023: v1.1.0[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Simplified Chinese and LATAM translations would be missing from some CH2 content.
[*] Fixed issue where Bug Expert achievement for perfect hits on the Mantis Boss wouldn’t correctly trigger. 
[*] Increased JJ’s movement speed in the overworld slightly.
[*] Added additional waypoints to Makati, Laguna and Cebu Maps.
[*] Widened camera for CH7 Cebu Rooms
[*] Addressed various collision and layering issues in Cebu and Laguna
[*] Disabled unused tutorial input in battle that was causing lag when pressed. 
[*] Fixed Layering issue with Centipede Mech tail attack. 
[*] Fixed issue with Overworld Music playing during the first second of cutscene.
[*] Fixed issue with some cutscene animations desyncing with sound effects.
[*] Fixed issue where JJ's solo ability in CH1 would get wiped if a player saved and reloaded.
[/list]
